name: domain-parkour
description: Minimalistic domain parking, coming soon and landing pages for Cloudflare Workers, with a built-in admin panel backed by D1.

scripts.db:console: wrangler d1 execute domain-parkour-db --local --command "SELECT hostname, mode, datetime(updated_at, 'unixepoch') AS updated FROM domains ORDER BY updated_at DESC"
scripts.db:inbox: wrangler d1 execute domain-parkour-db --local --command "SELECT datetime(created_at,'unixepoch') AS at, hostname, kind, status, email, subject, offer_amount, message, answer FROM submissions ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50"

author: Deepak Thomas
